description: This PHP file defines the 'Kpi' entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes ORM mappings to the 'ohrm_kpi' database table, properties representing KPI attributes like title, ratings, and related job title, and methods for accessing and mutating these properties.

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: Entity class representing a KPI (Key Performance Indicator) in the OrangeHRM system, with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the KPI.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the KPI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title or indicator name of the KPI.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title or indicator name of the KPI.

methods.name: getMinRating
methods.description: Gets the minimum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: setMinRating
methods.description: Sets the minimum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: getMaxRating
methods.description: Gets the maximum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: setMaxRating
methods.description: Sets the maximum rating value for the KPI.

methods.name: isDefaultKpi
methods.description: Checks if the KPI is marked as default.

methods.name: setDefaultKpi
methods.description: Sets the KPI as default or not.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this KPI.

methods.name: getDeletedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the KPI was marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeletedAt
methods.description: Sets the deletion timestamp for the KPI.
